name: Pager
summary: Small belt-clip pager with a tiny LCD and buttons; use for beeper, 90s office or on-call scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the base of the body rests on y; set y to a hand or belt height to place it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size, about 330 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.3 clipped to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: blink = LCD flickers and the status light pulses

author: krakujs
